summary: Drop can mint short-lived, narrowly scoped credentials so a sandboxed job writes only its own artifact.
details: A job is handed its own token that may only create one artifact, or only revise the single artifact it was given — never Nora's own master credential, and never write access to anything else.
The token expires on its own short deadline rather than needing to be revoked afterwards.
limitations: In use now that make_artifact is wired in: every job gets one. A job that outlives its token's deadline cannot write its result at all -- it fails rather than falling back to a wider credential.
